# Marketing API changelog

*SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: invented text that only mimics the page structure of a documentation changelog. It is not vendor documentation.*

The newest version in this sample is:

v9.0

This page lists changes to the sample API: those tied to a [version](#versioned) and those released [between versions](#outofcycle).

## 03/15/2027

### Usage headers

- The `x-usage` header now reports hourly and daily usage, separated by "|"
- New apps start with a limit of 200 calls per hour
- Requests that exceed the limit return status 429 with a retry hint

### Versioned changes {#versioned}

A new API version bundles its changes; the newest version gets them first. The upgrade guide explains how to move.

### Out-of-cycle changes {#outofcycle}

Changes released between versions normally take effect on every version straight away. They are listed here as they ship.
